summary: Discover the essentials of ISO/IEC 27701 Foundation. Enhance your knowledge on privacy information management and boost your organization's compliance today.
audienceIntro: This ISO/IEC 27701 Foundation course is intended for professionals who need a practical starting point in privacy information management and want to understand how a PIMS connects to existing security controls.
prerequisites: There are no formal prerequisites for this course. The training is suitable for you if you already work with information security, privacy, compliance, or PII-related processes and want a structured entry into ISO/IEC 27701 Foundation. No prior audit, implementation, or certification experience is required. Working familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001 or ISO/IEC 27002 is helpful but not mandatory. You should be prepared to read standard language, complete quizzes, and review scenario-based examples.
